content: {"reasoning":"The CO-197 denial concerns missing required prior authorization, and the payer offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. Eligibility, coding, and COB are correct, so resubmission would not address the denial. A formal medical-necessity appeal is available with this denial and is the next appropriate route to pursue payer payment without improperly shifting the full balance to the patient.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
